verses.text: Jakchajokab' b'e t'a te' k'ak' yik sb'at tz'ab'at te' k'ute' t'a Líbano.

Ok'okab' te' taj, yujto toxo ix telwi te' k'ute'. Ha juntzanh te te' manhxo jantakok swach'il chi', toxo ix lajwiel te'. Ok'okab' te' ji t'a yol yik Basán, yujto a te' niwak te', te k'ayum, toxo ix ch'akjiel te'.
Ab'ek wal yel yaw heb' tanhwum kalnel yok'i, yujto manhxalaj anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok' snok' heb'. Ab'ek pax yel yaw nok' choj, yujto toxo ix lajwiel niwak wayumtak t'a sti' ha' Jordán.
Ix yal Jehová in Diosal t'ayin icha tik: Tanhwej wal nok' kalnel to t'inhan smiljichamok.

Ha heb' smananel nok', malaj jab'ok sna heb' yuj b'aj smilcham nok', haxo heb' schonhan nok' chi', syal heb' icha tik: Yuj wal Dios, a tiknaik b'eyum onhxo, xchi heb'. Haxo pax heb' stanhwumal nok', manh jab'ok tz'ok' sk'ol heb' yuj nok'.

Ichinpaxta' a in tik, manh jab'ok ol ok' in k'ol t'a anima kajan t'a sat jun lu'um tik. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol laj wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yetchonhab' yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' sreyal heb'. Ha heb' chi' ol ixtanel sat lum lum tik, manhxo ol in kol-laj heb' anima chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi Jehová.

Ichato chi' ix in och in tanhwej nok' kalnel t'inhan smiljicham chi', haxo heb' manum kalnel chi' ix in tupani. Ix in sayan chab' te' k'okoch. Ay jun te' ix wak' skuch Wach'k'olal, haxo junxo te' ix wak' skuch Junnhej yaji.
Ha t'a jun ujal, oxwanh heb' tanhwum kalnel chi' ix in chek paxok, yujto manhxa in gana t'a heb', manhxa pax snib'ej heb' t'ayin.

Ix walan t'a nok' kalnel chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ex in tanhwej. Tato ay junok ex tzex chami, chamanhek. Tato ay junok mach tzex milanchamok, ex miljokab'chamok. Ha exxo tzex to kani, tze satlajel he b'a, xin chi t'a nok'.
Ix wik'ancha'anh te' in k'okoch ix wak' skuch Wach'k'olal, ix in lokan kanhchaj te', yik scheklajeli to slajwi strato Jehová ix sb'o yet' masanil chonhab'.
Haton t'a jun k'u chi', ix lajwikan jun trato chi', haxo heb' ay yik nok' kalnel chi', wan yilan heb' tas wan in k'ulan chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to a Jehová wan slolon yuj tas wan in k'ulan chi'.

Ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: Tato he gana, ak'ek in tojol, tato ma'ay jun, kanokab' icha chi', xin chi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' te niwan in tojol ix yak' heb' yalani, 30 nhej k'e'en plata ix yak' heb' t'ayin.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Te jab'tzin jab' in tojol ix yak' heb' tik, yuj chi' julkanb'at k'e'en b'aj sik'chaj k'e'en tumin t'a templo, xchi. Ix wik'anb'at k'e'en, ix in yumankanb'at k'e'en b'aj sik'chaj k'e'en tumin chi'.
Ix in lokan kanhchaj junxo te' k'okoch ix wak' skuch Junnhej yaji. Icha chi' ix aj in ch'oxani to manhxo junnhejok yaj Judá yet' Israel.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha tiknaik, utej a b'a icha jun tanhwum kalnel manh jab'ok syak'och sk'ol stanhwan nok' kalnel chi'.

Yujto ol wak'och junok stanhwumal jun nación tik, te chuk ol yutej sb'a icha junok tanhwum kalnel max yak' pensar yuj nok' kalnel satb'ati, max saylaj nok', max yanhtejpax nok' echen yaji, max yak'paxlaj swa'el nok' scham yuj wejel. Palta to schib'at nok' b'ak'ech, masanil k'e'en yech nok' schib'ati.
Ob'iltak wal jun stanhwumal in chonhab' malaj pensar chi', yujto syaktejkan tas stanhwej. Sikb'okab'el swach' k'ab', tzepjokab'el t'a k'e'en espada, ik'jokab'paxk'eta yol sat t'a swach', xchi Jehová.
